caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement centered around a large stylized tulip-like flower at the top, colored in red, yellow, and a touch of blue. Directly beneath this flower is a yellow heart with a red outline, also edged in blue and yellow, with mirrored stems curving outwards from its base. Two red and blue birds, each with a blue crown-like crest and yellow, blue, and brown details on the body and wings, are perched on either side of the heart, facing each other. Each bird has one foot on a blue stem and the other raised. Beneath the heart, there is a stylized purple and yellow vase with handles, from which the stems and leaves of the central flower and two smaller red-and-yellow tulip-like flowers extend sideways. Above the entire arrangement, flanking the main flower, are two blue and white birds in flight facing inward. The background is a beige or light tan paper, with some visible pencil marks and text at the bottom indicating information about the drawing.
title: Drawing for Plate 15: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
